segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Sells medical devices, including masks, through its PRC subsidiaries to customers, doctors and patients.
segments.evidence: As a result of the assessment made by CODM, the Group has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for medical devices, mainly masks, that its PRC subsidiaries sell.
revenueModel.evidence: Furthermore, our net revenue from sales of masks decreased to $640,428, or approximately 6.50% of our total net revenue, for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025.
